command: python3 -m sprat.cli add-user analyst analyst && GID=$(python3 -m sprat.cli create analyst goal "Protect user data" --content "Objective to elaborate" | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["id"])') && SID=$(python3 -m sprat.cli create analyst scenario "Analyst reviews access logs" --content "Use case realising the goal" | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["id"])') && python3 -m sprat.cli link analyst "$GID" "$SID"
